activity.notes: Crowfoot became a minor chief of a Siksika band in 1865 and emerged as one of the principal head chiefs after the 1869–1870 smallpox epidemic, remaining a central Siksika political leader until his death in 1890. ATLAS uses Siksika rather than falsely portraying him as a unitary sovereign over the entire Blackfoot Confederacy.

sources.title: ISAPO-MUXIKA (Crowfoot) — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography records Crowfoot's rise to minor chief in 1865, later emergence as a head chief of the Blackfoot tribe, and death on 25 April 1890.
